title: JMAP blob download: account_id not validated against authenticated user
description: mail/blob.rs:13-37: /jmap/download/:account_id/:blob_id/:name — account_id is logged but never validated against authenticated session. Once IPFS fetch is wired, a user can craft a URL with another account's account_id and retrieve their blobs. Fix: validate account_id matches the authenticated principal before fetching from IPFS. Currently IPFS is stubbed (501), so this is latent — must be fixed before IPFS is wired.
notes: Fixed as side effect of stoa-31947539.2
